title: Retaining Repair Hypotheses for Cost-Aware Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.39410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Several corrections of an executable model can fit the same observations while predicting different execution outcomes. We study a repair-to-execution interface that retains compatible finite guard repairs, conditions their weights on diagnostic and ordinary-execution observations, and uses their predictions to choose routes, priced tests, or a backup. On 24 synthetic two-stage devices, an equal mixture of a language-model-generated repair and a uniform belief over compatible repairs (the AI-weighted belief) lowers no-test cost by 2.14 percent relative to committing to the generated repair. Access charges can erase the benefit of diagnosis on isolated tasks, while repeated work can recover it under the AI-weighted belief. With normal-execution learning in every repeated-work arm, workload-valued testing costs 3.33 percent less than same-budget random selection under the AI-weighted belief. Weighting changes the comparison: uniform normal

translated_title: 面向成本感知执行的修复假设保留方法
translated_abstract: 可执行模型的多个修正方案可以拟合相同的观测结果，却对执行结果做出不同的预测。我们研究了一种从修复到执行的接口，该接口保留相互兼容的有限守卫修复，并依据诊断观测和普通执行观测对这些修复的权重进行条件化，进而利用它们的预测来选择执行路线、定价测试或备份方案。在24个合成的两阶段设备实验中，将语言模型生成的修复与兼容修复上的均匀信念等权混合（即AI加权信念），相对于直接采用生成的修复，可将无测试成本降低2.14%。访问收费可能抵消诊断在孤立任务上带来的收益，而重复性工作可以在AI加权信念下挽回这一收益。在每个重复工作分支中都引入正常执行学习的情况下，在AI加权信念下，按工作量计价的测试相比相同预算下的随机选择可节省3.33%的成本。权重的设定会改变比较结果：均匀正……
tldr: 该论文提出一种保留多个兼容修复假设并根据诊断与执行观测动态加权的修复—执行接口，利用AI加权信念降低测试成本达3.33%，并在重复性任务中挽回诊断的价值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a repair-to-execution interface that retains multiple compatible repair hypotheses and reweights them using diagnostic and execution observations, showing that an AI-weighted belief cuts testing costs by up to 3.33% and recovers the value of diagnosis in repeated workloads.
